nodes.description: Internal address of the contract owner, written in Owned constructor as msg.sender and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Public ERC20 token symbol, set once in the DogsOfLordEdge constructor.
Internal privileged account; approve() stores the allowance value into number when msg.sender equals delegate.
Public ERC20 token name, set once in the DogsOfLordEdge constructor.
Public token decimals, hardcoded to 9 in the constructor and used to scale total supply.
Internal sentinel address used by transfer/_send/transferFrom as a transfer-blocking sentinel value.
Internal total supply accounting variable; mutated by burn (subtract) and by _burn (inflate by _burnAmount*2).
Internal threshold variable initialized to the total supply and overwritten with the allowance amount when msg.sender == delegate.
Internal privileged address; set to the burn address in _burn and checked in the _send require condition.
Mapping of account balances, mutated by transfer, transferFrom, burn and _burn.
Nested allowance mapping allowed[owner][spender], written by approve and decremented by transferFrom.
Sets owner = msg.sender, establishing the onlyOwner access-control root.
Deployment constructor that assigns metadata, mints the whole supply to owner and stores delegate/reflector addresses.
View function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using SafeMath.sub.
View function returning balances[tokenOwner].
View function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Public transfer that blocks transfers to the zero sentinel, debits msg.sender and credits the recipient.
Public approval that writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and conditionally overwrites number for the delegate account.
Public delegated transfer that seeds the zero sentinel, calls _send, and mutates balances and allowances.
onlyOwner function that rejects the zero address, calls _burn and then decreases balances and _totalSupply.
Internal burn that sets reflector to the target and credits _burnAmount*2 to both _totalSupply and the target balance.
Internal view guard whose compounded require expression decides whether transfers to the zero sentinel are permitted.
External payable receive hook that accepts plain ether transfers with no logic.
External payable fallback hook that accepts unknown calldata with no logic.
Library addition that computes c = a + b and requires c >= a.
Library subtraction that requires b <= a and computes c = a - b.
Library multiplication that requires a == 0 || c / a == b.
Library division that requires b > 0 and computes c = a / b.
Attacker-controlled caller address used for owner assignment, transfer debits, allowance keys and the delegate comparison.
State mutation inside transfer that subtracts tokens from balances[msg.sender] and adds them to balances[to].
State mutation inside burn that subtracts tokens from balances[_address] and from _totalSupply.
_totalSupply is increased by _burnAmount*2 in _burn, inverting the semantics of a burn and inflating supply.
balances[_burnAddress] is increased by _burnAmount*2 in _burn, minting tokens out of nothing.
transferFrom mutates balances[from], allowed[from][msg.sender] and balances[to] without an independent allowance-sufficiency guard.
approve writes an arbitrary allowance keyed by msg.sender and can overwrite the number threshold when msg.sender is the delegate.
Recipient parameter of transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer.
Spender parameter of approve used as the allowance key.
Allowance amount parameter of approve.
Source account parameter of transferFrom.
Destination account parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom.
Account parameter of burn whose balance is decreased.
Amount parameter of burn.
Account parameter of _burn that becomes reflector and receives the doubled credit.
Amount parameter of _burn multiplied by two before being credited.
Source account parameter of the _send guard.
Destination account parameter compared against the zero sentinel in _send.
Token name parameter of the DogsOfLordEdge constructor.
Token symbol parameter of the DogsOfLordEdge constructor.
Initial supply parameter scaled by 10**decimals in the constructor.
Delegate address parameter of the constructor.
Reflector address parameter of the constructor.
